headline: Metrocon Amends MOM Probe Timeline and Retains Director
summary: Metrocon amended the timeline of a Ministry of Manpower probe that led to its chairman quitting, while retaining his wife as a director following charges related to an unlicensed foreign worker dormitory.
why: Corporate governance disclosures and regulatory investigations provide transparency regarding management integrity and executive continuity.

impacts.name: Metrocon
impacts.why: Regulatory investigations involving executive leadership impact corporate governance assessments.
